items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Amelie Vaughn is the name of the interviewee herself.

ctx.x: 29th, I believe, 1960. Anyway, it's a Friday. And let's get your name down, the first thing. Your full name.
Full name, that's right, Amelie Vaughn.
And people call you Mealy, though, huh?
